sources.title: Amazon Associates Standard Commission Income Statement (official Table 1 rate schedule)
sources.used_for: Fixed commission rates by category, bounty events, fine-art cap, 0.00% exclusions
sources.notes: Read directly by the final integration session on 2026-11-14. Table 1 lists: Luxury Beauty / Luxury Stores Beauty / Amazon Explore 10.00%; Digital Music / Physical Music / Handmade / Digital Videos 5.00%; Physical Books / Kitchen / Automotive 4.50%; Fire Tablet, Kindle, Luxury Stores Fashion, Apparel, Fire TV, Echo, Ring, Watches, Jewelry, Luggage, Shoes, Handbags and Accessories 4.00%; Toys, Furniture, Home, Home Improvement, Lawn and Garden, Pets, Headphones, Beauty, Musical Instruments, Business and Industrial Supplies, Outdoors, Tools, Sports, Baby Products, Amazon Coins 3.00%; PC and PC Components 2.50%; Televisions and Digital Video Games 2.00%; Amazon Fresh, Physical Video Games, Grocery, Health and Personal Care 1.00%; Gift Cards, Wireless Service Plans, Alcohol, Digital Kindle subscriptions, Vehicle Leasing and Sales, Pet Prescription Medications, Restaurant-prepared Food, Amazon Appstore, Prime Now and Amazon Pay Places 0.00%; Coach 0.00%; All Other Categories 4.00%. This is the official public table, which is why the rate is no longer blank. The commission category Amazon assigns to a specific ASIN is still not confirmable from outside Associates Central (F-01). Re-read 2026-11-16 (arena/4c552c78-zone4): Table 1 still lists 'Physical Books, Kitchen, Automotive' at 4.50% and 'Home' at 3.00%. Unchanged.

sources.used_for: Commission Income Statement sections 1, 2(a) to 2(k), 3 and 4; Participation Requirements sections 1, 2(a), 2(b), 3(a) to 3(f), 4, 5, 6(a) to 6(z); Trademark Guidelines 1 to 8; Associates Program IP License sections 1, 2(a) to 2(k), 3 and 4 (Agent Terms); Products Statement 1 to 3; Influencer Program Policy; Creator Ads Boost. Commission Income Statement sections 1–2 (Qualifying Purchases, Qualifying Revenue, disqualified purchases incl. 2(c) paid search and 2(d)–(e) search and redirecting links); Standard Commission Income is in the Appendix, which links to the schedule URL (see S-SCHED).
